name: NVIDIA Jetson Nano Developer Kit

outline.source: NVIDIA Jetson Nano Developer Kit datasheet (NVIDIA): 100 x 80 mm carrier board (overall 100 x 80 x 29 mm with the module and heatsink); corner radius approximate

pcb.source: typical FR4 board thickness; not published

mounting_holes.source: ASSUMED pattern: NVIDIA's carrier board specification does not publish the mounting hole positions; measure them from the NVIDIA STEP model (measure_reference_part) before building

connectors.name: Jetson module and heatsink (keepout)
connectors.source: coarse keepout box: the module and heatsink stand in the middle of the board; the 29 mm overall height is NVIDIA's published figure
connectors.note: footprint assumed; only the overall height is published; no wall opening

omitted: every wall connector (USB 3.0 stacks, HDMI, DisplayPort, Gigabit Ethernet, DC jack, micro-USB): their positions are not published; import the NVIDIA STEP model and measure it
40-pin header, camera (CSI) connectors, M.2 slot, fan header
